name: Discord Presence
description: Shows your Discord status and Rich Presence (game, mode, progress, elapsed time, party size, map / rank tooltips) every 60 seconds, with a one-tap "playing now" post button while in a game. Add a shared server ID to list which members of that server are currently in a game, grouped by game (what your friends are up to). Uses Lanyard (requires joining discord.gg/lanyard) and Discord's official server widget; no API key needed.
